rationale: The deictic phrase "most current" is read at the 2026-07-21 audit time. Adobe states that Flash Player support stopped on 2020-12-31 and Flash content was blocked from 2021-01-12, so no supported current Flash Player version remains. However, the supplied evidence does not identify or establish that frozen version 28.0.0.137 was valid at or near the 2019 reference time; therefore a superseded-retirement verdict cannot be supported.
